title: eval-harness: add prompt-regression CI hook with thresholded quality gating
author: Priya Menon
description: Add a CI hook to the eval-harness that runs prompt-set regression checks and enforces thresholded quality gates on PRs that touch model or prompt artifacts. Motivation: we've had intermittent regressions in prompt outputs after model/opti changes; the CI gate prevents accidental quality degradation by blocking merges when defined eval metrics drop below configured thresholds. This PR implements a lightweight hook that runs a subset of the eval suite (fast prompt-sets) against the target model revision, compares delta against baseline, and fails CI if any metric falls below the configured tolerance. Key behaviors: 1) hook runs only when changed files match (eval/prompt_sets/*, models/*, infra/eval-configs/*) or when the PR label includes 'eval-run'. 2) Thresholds are configurable via eval-configs/ci-gates.yaml with per-prompt-set and per-metric tolerances and an override for individual PRs. 3) CI runs are cached to avoid repeated long runs; we store artifacts and reuse them when head commit has only docs/style changes. 4) Failure mode provides a human-readable summary in the PR comment and attaches raw metric artifacts for debugging. Includes tests, the gating config schema, a small baseline recording for two fast prompt-sets, and a console status check integration. Checklist: - [x] implement hook and gating logic - [x] add schema and example configs - [x] add unit and integration tests - [x] add baseline artifacts for fast prompt-sets - [x] update docs with usage and override process - [x] verified on staging CI and production runs
